title: Plant Manager
text:
SET THE VISION. LEAD WITH PURPOSE. DRIVE OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE.

Plant Manager | Full-Time | Salary

AUTOKINITON | Chicago, IL (relocation available)

Are you an experienced manufacturing leader who knows how to bring people together, strengthen operations, and turn business goals into measurable results? At AUTOKINITON, you'll have the opportunity to lead an entire plant, develop future leaders, and drive the safety, quality, productivity, and financial performance that keep our business moving forward.

WHO WE ARE

At AUTOKINITON, our work helps shape the vehicles people drive every day. As a trusted partner to the world's leading automakers, we take pride in building high-quality structural components that contribute to vehicle strength, durability, and safety. But what truly drives our success is our people. Guided by our core value, “We, Not I,” we believe in teamwork, continuous improvement, and creating opportunities for every associate to contribute, grow, and succeed. Join a team where your leadership makes a difference, your ideas drive improvement, and we're building the future of mobility together.

PURPOSE: WHAT YOU'LL DO

As Plant Manager, you'll provide strategic and hands-on leadership across all plant operations, building a strong team while delivering results for our customers and our business.

* Lead Plant Performance: Direct daily operations to achieve safety, quality, productivity, delivery, and financial goals.

* Develop Strong Leaders: Coach, mentor, and develop the leadership team and salaried associates, building accountability and future management talent.

* Drive Business Results: Own plant financial performance, manage budgets and staffing levels, and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce costs.

* Build a Culture of Safety: Lead plant safety initiatives, strengthen EHS accountability, and ensure compliance with company policies and OSHA requirements.

* Improve Operations: Champion lean manufacturing, structured problem-solving, and continuous improvement to increase productivity and eliminate waste.

* Deliver for Customers: Build strong customer relationships, lead customer visits and presentations, and ensure plant performance consistently meets or exceeds expectations.

* Shape the Business Strategy: Develop and execute the plant's strategic business plan, aligning measurable goals with broader North American business objectives.

* Support Growth and Innovation: Partner with commercial, engineering, and program teams on new business opportunities, customer launches, plant capacity, and operational readiness.

* Strengthen Teamwork: Create an engaged, collaborative environment where associates have the resources, direction, and support to succeed.

WHAT MAKES YOU A GREAT FIT?

* Bachelor's degree in Business or a related field; preference for Manufacturing, Engineering, or Quality. Master's degree preferred.

* Minimum of 8-10 years of manufacturing leadership experience as a Plant Manager, Operations Manager, or Department Manager, with metals manufacturing experience preferred, with at least 5 years within a weld and assembly facility.

* Experience with Just-in-Time (JIT) manufacturing, including production scheduling, inventory management, and material flow principles.

* Experience leading new program launches and implementing lean manufacturing principles.

* Proven ability to lead, coach, mentor, and develop high-performing teams.

* Strong business and financial acumen, including the ability to interpret operating metrics and financial performance data.

* Knowledge of quality and environmental management systems, including IATF 16949 and ISO 14001.

* Excellent organizational, analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office; QAD and supply chain experience preferred.

* Ability to translate business strategies and progressive manufacturing practices into measurable operational improvements.

WHY BUILD YOUR CAREER WITH AUTOKINITON?

* Competitive compensation

* Medical, dental, and vision coverage

* 401(k) company contribution and match

* Up to 15 paid holidays, including our holiday bridge schedule

* Tuition reimbursement

* Professional development, training, and career advancement opportunities

* A collaborative, team-focused culture built on continuous improvement

READY TO LEAD THE WAY?

Bring your leadership experience, business mindset, and passion for manufacturing to AUTOKINITON. Apply today and help drive the future of our business!

AUTOKINITON promotes a dynamic and collaborative work environment for everyone.

AUTOKINITON is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. AUTOKINITON makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.
